blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Human Rights Watch (HRW) on Thursday urged Southeast Asian leaders gathering in the Philippines this weekend to increase pressure on Myanmar’s military junta to end attacks on civilians, lift restrictions on humanitarian assistance and begin credible dialogue on a transition to civilian rule. In a Nov. 5 letter to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., the Philippines’ president and 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) chair, HRW also called on the regional bloc to maintain its refusal to recognize or endorse what it described as sham elections earlier this year that resulted in junta leader Min Aung Hlaing assuming […]...
